ctx.x: They didn't play. They played true Dixieland.

Oh I see. They played with a beat and they had good men. I remember distinctly that one Sunday, we gave a Sunday matinee, and I had to play the matinee for which I got off on Monday night. The other band called themselves the Circle Quintet, and they were my friends supposedly, but I think they would like to take me down a notch or two, you see? So they brought Bix Spider back in there. Well I said, is that Bix Spider back? They said yes. I said, well I have nothing to worry about. And I went home. Because it…
